title: wk-tool first-use nudge (ref)
desc: Incidents and the recognition-criterion behind the wk-tool to skill nudge.
steps: RECOGNITION CRITERION (2026-06-24): the tool/guard token must be IN the skill id for a read to be CREDITED -- this single rule drives the nudge, the study-lock currency, and the studied-index credit.

INCIDENT wkhippo: hippocampus-living-memory does NOT contain 'wkhippo' literally, so recognition failed until an explicit tool-to-skill map entry was added -- the exception proving the rule (strip-wk gives 'hippo', a token-boundary prefix of 'hippocampus').

INCIDENT harness-wk-only-gate: a near-duplicate pair (wkharness-wk-only-gate registers, harness-wk-only-gate does not) deadlocked the guards-write study-lock -- fix via strip-wk normalize so wkharness-X equals harness-X, or dedup.
SAFETY: match on token boundary, never arbitrary substring (false-positives).
author: claude
